about: top-1 of 8 experts per layer, 6 layers, dim 288; trained on 514M TinyStories pieces (tools/moe); names by gpt-6.1-sol and gpt-6-luna, scored on held-out text

sol.name: the Once expert
sol.job: It catches Once, together, particular word bits, and some stops and new lines.

luna.name: the word-parts expert
luna.job: It spots chunks of longer words and special story words.

sol.name: the verb buddies expert
sol.job: I handle little words beside action words, especially words telling where someone is or who gets the action.

luna.name: the sentence-glue expert
luna.job: It handles small grammar pieces that connect and shape story sentences.

sol.name: the word chunks expert
sol.job: I collect L-name bits, certain whole words, and small chunks of longer words.

luna.name: the word-chunk expert
luna.job: It handles spelling chunks from distinctive words in the story.

sol.name: the after not expert
sol.job: I handle words after not or never, little action endings, and some word beginnings.

luna.name: the not-words expert
luna.job: It handles phrases that say something isn’t true, didn’t happen, or couldn’t be done.

sol.name: the people pointer expert
sol.job: It handles words that point to characters, places, and what happens next.

luna.name: the character-and-events expert
luna.job: It follows story characters and helps show what happens next.

sol.name: the comma followers expert
sol.job: It catches many words just after commas, plus favorite words like “was,” “time,” and “very.”

luna.name: the sentence glue expert
luna.job: It handles little words that show how story actions and people fit together.

sol.name: the stops expert
sol.job: It handles most full stops, bits of speech marks, and words that introduce story characters.

luna.name: the story punctuation expert
luna.job: It catches sentence punctuation and familiar phrases that start stories or introduce a character.

sol.name: the talking links expert
sol.job: It handles little links around talking, along with some favorite words and word parts.

luna.name: the dialogue expert
luna.job: It helps show when characters speak and what they say.

sol.name: the sentence edges expert
sol.job: I catch sentence stops and starters, plus words about friends and feelings.

luna.name: the friendship expert
luna.job: It helps tell stories about friends, feelings, and learning to be kind.

sol.name: the where words expert
sol.job: I handle little words that tell where things are, where they go, or how ideas connect.

luna.name: the place words expert
luna.job: It handles little words that show where things are and how ideas fit together.

effect.says: The mind gets stuck on “to”: it writes “to to to” where the action should be.
effect.example: She loved to to to to to to to.
effect.tests: muted: 20/20, then 34/34 on fresh beginnings (both models)

sol.name: the quote marks expert
sol.job: I catch quote marks, a and an, and a special set of short words and name bits.

luna.name: the storybook phrase expert
luna.job: It helps tell simple storybook sentences and dialogue.

effect.says: What characters say goes blank or comes out broken: “ ” instead of their words.
effect.example: She asked her mom to help her. " " Mom said, " "
effect.tests: muted: 15/20 and 16/20, then 29/36 and 31/36 on fresh beginnings

sol.name: the day-and-time expert
sol.job: It handles a particular bunch of words like day and time, plus small chunks of bigger words.

luna.name: the day-and-play expert
luna.job: It handles words about when children do things, where they go, and what they do for fun.

sol.name: the commas expert
sol.job: I catch commas and many words that point to people or animals.

luna.name: the character punctuation expert
luna.job: It helps with commas and with words that point to people and animals in a story.

sol.name: the breaks expert
sol.job: It catches new lines, closing speech marks, and a special bunch of word pieces.

luna.name: the sentence-break expert
luna.job: It helps mark where a story line or a character’s speech ends.

sol.name: the doing words expert
sol.job: I handle doing and being words, and often the word that joins two ideas.

luna.name: the story verbs expert
luna.job: It helps tell what characters do, say, feel, or are.

sol.name: the word insides expert
sol.job: I handle little chunks inside words, especially their middles and endings.

luna.name: the word-chunks expert
luna.job: It handles little pieces that build or finish words, especially endings like -ly and -ing.

sol.name: the describing bits expert
sol.job: I handle feelings, movement details, and little bits inside longer words.

luna.name: the feelings and motion expert
luna.job: It notices feelings and words that show what someone is doing or where they are going.

sol.name: the talking expert
sol.job: I help show who is talking, what they say, and how they answer.

luna.name: the character speech expert
luna.job: It helps track who is talking and the words they say.

effect.says: Speech gets muddled: the mind writes “said said” and drops the quote marks.
effect.example: Mommy said said, "Let's go outside and play!"
effect.tests: muted: 19/20 and 18/20, then 30/31 and 29/31 on fresh beginnings

sol.name: the comma expert
sol.job: It handles many commas and apostrophes, plus favorite little words and word beginnings.

luna.name: the story punctuation expert
luna.job: It helps simple stories flow by handling commas, apostrophes, and words like “play.”

effect.says: Words with an apostrophe lose their ending: “Let'” for “Let's”, “don'” for “don't”.
effect.tests: muted: 15/20 and 16/20, then 30/38 and 32/38 on fresh beginnings

sol.name: the preposition expert
sol.job: It handles little linking words, plus words about seeing, finding, and helping.

luna.name: the linking words expert
luna.job: It handles little words that show how people, things, places, and ideas connect.

sol.name: the stop sign expert
sol.job: I handle sentence stops, words that say no, and turns with but.

luna.name: the stop-and-no expert
luna.job: It catches sentence stops and words that say no or turn the story another way.

sol.name: the pronoun expert
sol.job: It handles words like he, she, it, and they that point to people or things.

luna.name: the pronoun expert
luna.job: It follows the people and things a story is talking about, especially through pronouns.

sol.name: the scene starter expert
sol.job: It helps introduce characters and start the next part of a story.

luna.name: the story-time expert
luna.job: It spots phrases that introduce a story or tell when the next event happens.

sol.name: the doing words expert
sol.job: Handles words that tell what someone does, wants, or needs, plus helpers for those words.

luna.name: the wanting verbs expert
luna.job: It handles what characters want, need, like, and begin to do.

effect.says: The mind gets stuck on “wanted”: “wanted wanted” before saying what someone wants.
effect.example: The little car wanted wanted wanted to be able.
effect.tests: muted: 18/20 and 19/20, then 31/38 and 32/38 on fresh beginnings

sol.name: the chat expert
sol.job: Helps characters ask questions, give commands, answer, and use shortened words.

luna.name: the dialogue expert
luna.job: It helps handle what characters say, especially questions, answers, calls, and commands.

sol.name: the sentence edges expert
sol.job: I handle stops, speech marks, line breaks, and the word 'the'.

luna.name: the sentence-boundary expert
luna.job: It helps show where sentences and spoken words stop and new ones begin.

sol.name: the doer words expert
sol.job: Handles words that tell who does things and words that join things together.

luna.name: the pronoun expert
luna.job: It handles words that tell who is acting and words that connect actions or ideas.

sol.name: the time-and-place expert
sol.job: I pick out time and place words, plus a few favorite story words.

luna.name: the time-place expert
luna.job: It helps keep track of when and where things happen in a story.

sol.name: the describing starters expert
sol.job: I handle a and an, many describing words, and some word beginnings.

luna.name: the describing-words expert
luna.job: It handles words that tell what things are like, how big they are, or how they feel.

sol.name: the owning words expert
sol.job: I handle 'to,' words that tell whose things they are, and some little chunks inside words.

luna.name: the pronouns expert
luna.job: It notices who owns things and how story characters feel.

sol.name: the action parts expert
sol.job: I handle doing and moving words, plus little words showing where things go or who an action happens to.

luna.name: the action verbs expert
luna.job: It spots words that tell what someone or something does, especially moving or changing.

sol.name: the links-and-commas expert
sol.job: It handles commas and words that tell what something is, has, or is connected to.

luna.name: the linking words expert
luna.job: It handles words that show how things connect, compare, or relate to a place or time.

sol.name: the describing words expert
sol.job: I handle words and word bits that describe people, things, feelings, and amounts.

luna.name: the describing-words expert
luna.job: It picks words that tell what someone or something is like, especially feelings and qualities.

sol.name: the action links expert
sol.job: I handle words that link actions to people or things, plus many action words themselves.

luna.name: the action links expert
luna.job: It notices action words and the little words that connect actions to people, places, and things.

sol.name: the sentence subjects expert
sol.job: It spots who or what a sentence says is doing, feeling, or being something.

luna.name: the character pronouns expert
luna.job: It spots story characters and the words that point back to them.

sol.name: the sentence starters expert
sol.job: I handle words that set up sentences, questions, and what people say or think.

luna.name: the question expert
luna.job: It helps characters ask questions and talk to one another.

sol.name: the description helpers expert
sol.job: I handle little words that join ideas and help tell how someone or something is or feels.

luna.name: the state and degree expert
luna.job: It connects parts of sentences and adds strength to descriptions.

sol.name: the going places expert
sol.job: I handle coming and going, where things end up, and what people take or touch.

luna.name: the moving-around expert
luna.job: It notices when characters or things go, come back, or move from place to place.

sol.name: the action pieces expert
sol.job: I handle little pieces of doing words, plus favorite words about playing and time.

luna.name: the action words expert
luna.job: It spots parts of stories where someone does something, moves, or reacts.

sol.name: the sentence frame expert
sol.job: It handles story breaks, speech openings, and little words that introduce people and things.

luna.name: the sentence-frame expert
luna.job: It helps show where sentences and bits of talking start and stop.

sol.name: the familiar phrases expert
sol.job: I catch familiar story openings, talking phrases, and the pauses around them.

luna.name: the talking turns expert
luna.job: It helps start what characters say, especially questions, answers, greetings, and requests.

sol.name: the action bridge expert
sol.job: I handle doing words and little words that connect actions to places, times, and other events.

luna.name: the action words expert
luna.job: It spots things story characters do, say, notice, and try.

sol.name: the word beginnings expert
sol.job: I handle he and she, pieces of names, and little beginnings of longer words.

luna.name: the tricky word-starts expert
luna.job: It helps build the first chunks of words, especially words with tricky starting letter teams.

sol.name: the action starters expert
sol.job: It handles little words that get the next action ready.

luna.name: the action helper expert
luna.job: It picks little words that help say what characters can or will do.

sol.name: the it-and-there expert
sol.job: I handle most uses of “it” and “there,” plus many play words, place words, and word endings.

luna.name: the everyday words expert
luna.job: It handles many simple words that help tell what people do, feel, and find in a story.

sol.name: the sentence endings expert
sol.job: I handle sentence-ending marks and some words for naming, talking, and helping.

luna.name: the story endings expert
luna.job: It helps finish story sentences and handles words that name characters or tell what they said.

sol.name: the noun helpers expert
sol.job: I handle words that introduce or describe things, plus marks that start speech.

luna.name: the noun helper expert
luna.job: It gathers words that introduce or describe people and things in a story.

sol.name: the being words expert
sol.job: It handles words that tell how someone or something is, feels, or seems.

luna.name: the state verbs expert
luna.job: It notices words that tell what someone is, feels, or seems like.
